topics.label: Introduction and Course Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the cancer biology lecture series and outlines the key learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Experimental Models of Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how accumulated genetic alterations disrupt normal developmental differentiation and tissue architecture, alongside laboratory approaches to culture tumor cells.

topics.label: Invasion, Metastasis, and Stepwise Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how local tissue invasion and metastatic spread distinguish malignant tumors from benign precursors using colorectal cancer progression as a histological model.

topics.label: Tumor Nomenclature and Classification
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions and notable exceptions for naming benign and malignant neoplasms based on their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Pathological Causes of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the physiological disruptions, systemic complications, and organ failures through which primary and metastatic tumors cause disease and death.

topics.label: Cancer Epidemiology Across Humans and Animals
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the distribution and frequency of various tumor types in human populations and across diverse multicellular species.

topics.label: Principles and Methods of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the rationale, clinical execution, and relative effectiveness of screening protocols for detecting pre-malignant and early-stage cancers.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a review of learning outcomes and practical session housekeeping.
